name: openregister:example-set:install
description: Install a story example set across every enabled app, for a demo or test instance
arguments: The set id; openregister:example-set:list shows them
options: Validate every object against its schema; writes no account, group or object (a missing required register is still imported, and a missing cast organisation created)
An existing account id the set may use although it did not create it; remove leaves it in place
Rewrite every object the set declares and already holds to its current values (dates against today, cast, lookups); objects the set did not write are left alone
Also refresh the set once a day from now on, so its dates follow the day it is viewed (a demo instance)
Stop the daily refresh of the set
Use the environment variable OC_PASS as the password of every new account instead of making one each
